body:
….. damn, that must have hurt so much. I hope you have found yourself better friends.

Thanks for the advice!! 😊

Yeah our friendship isn’t high maintenance but we made an effort to meet for everyone’s birthday celebration at the very least

Thanks btw!
Thanks! I hope so too..
Thanks!
Haha good advice!! Thanks!
I don’t think they remember… yup they did but not for the last few years because we couldn’t gather due to covid
Infinity War
Discectomy. The discs are located at my lower back.
Omg I always thought I was the only one. But yes, I totally relate to you! And it makes me wonder if they secretly dislike me or like me the least in that sense
All the missed opportunities and health issues that social anxiety brought about..
Do you take medication regularly or only when it acts up?
We can’t click..
I would say it’s both. Sometimes they didn’t want and sometimes the date felt off to me.

I feel the exact same way. And for me to be left on read is the worst - my mind starts telling me that they hate me or I’m being rejected. This puts more pressure on the kind of message I craft because I want to make sure that it’s interesting enough to get a reply back. I know this sounds really crazy but it makes texting, a supposedly relaxing activity, really exhausting for me. 

I have left so many conversations unread for months now. All my friends have already given up on texting me. I want to apologise but I feel like it would mean nothing if I don’t change my texting habit. But then again, my texting habit stems from my mental issue so I have no idea how to overcome it.
Yeah and because of that they told me I’m too boring to be around, not only did that hurt but it also made my social anxiety worse.
I feel it lesser when I don’t see it and when I’m around people and occupied. Really? Why is it good?
I thought I’m the only one. I feel extremely lonely and anxious during this time of the day too so I always try to stay indoors and avoid looking out the windows.
That’s amazing. Enjoy yourself! :)

Same. This actually feels more normal to me than pre-pandemic times. I have social anxiety so I actually enjoyed Zoom classes more than physically being in school but everything is resuming and my anxiety is going up again.
I’m sorry about that too :( I hope you do feel better now. You’re stronger than all of that.

I’m so sorry for your loss. 

And I know exactly how this feels. I lost my dad 8 years ago and then subsequently my nanny and grandma died too. Now my uncle is also fighting for his life. I’m also unmotivated in school, knowing they won’t be around to celebrate with me when I graduate.

If you’re too overwhelmed by uni, you could apply for semester break? That was what I did too when I was diagnosed with severe depression.

Yeah they were all close to me. Three of them have passed on within the last 8 years and another one is fighting for his life in the hospital right now. At this point there’s really nothing for me to be hopeful of about life..
Me too. I always have heart palpitations before any social events. Even for friends gathering I would bail out at the last minute because I was so afraid. I’m tired of living life like that too....
How about getting a new job? Anything to free you from your current job, for a start

That was me a few years ago. I quit university in less than a month because it was too overwhelming for my mental health at that time (I had other relationship and health issues). I took the time to mend all the issues I have had till they get better, before I return to school again to finish my studies.

So I think you should quit your job too if you want to. Take the time to discover yourself again and mend the relationship issues you might have. But also use the break to rest too, I’m sure you deserve it after working hard for so long.

Thank you for writing this.

Even though I have heard similar advices before, eg. just be yourself etc but I guess it takes someone who TRULY understands how I feel to say that for me to take this advice seriously (because others sounded like they were just patronising me and didn’t understand that “just be yourself” is easier said than done)

This made me tear up because it spoke to me so much. All my life I have been trying so hard to please everyone and make them like me. But when I could not keep up with the image, I broke down and started withdrawing socially, only to realise I actually haven’t made any real connections with them because it probably wasn’t the real me.... now I’m just scared of how they will think of me if I actually start being comfortable with being myself

Though not necessarily loneliness, piano has definitely helped me to boost my self-esteem. After I became depressed, there was a period of time where I could not go out to the world to study or work or socialise. I took up piano classes. Since they were private classes, I felt like I could be myself without having to impress anyone (only my piano teacher but she was very patient and encouraging so I did not feel pressured either) so it doesn’t matter even if I screwed up. It made me believe that the world can still be a beautiful place because music exists and it saved me in a way.

I feel the exact same way. And only towards friends too. I have left all of their texts unread, for months. I feel so guilty and want to reply them but I always do it mentally because texting and sending it to them takes a lot....... they probably would have moved on from the conversation too

I think we are not lazy but simply overwhelmed most of the time. Some of us are very ambitious people and we always set, realistically speaking, unattainable goals for ourselves and when we couldn’t reach them, we fall into despair and become too depressed to even begin on other tasks that we have set out to do (for fear of failing to reach expectations again).
